name: Micro Festival EUREKA! #13
description: The Micro Festival EUREKA! #13 features performances, workshops, and conversations centered on the theme of Altered States of Consciousness. It takes place on a Sunday afternoon at Espaço Porta-Jazz.
longDescription:
The Micro Festival EUREKA! #13 is a community and exploratory micro-festival held at Espaço Porta-Jazz. This edition focuses on the theme of Altered States of Consciousness, exploring perception, reality, and transcendence through various lenses.

The event includes performances, workshops, and presentations or conversations led by notable guests. It aims to encourage reflection, debate, and mutual inspiration, connecting participants and the public in an informal setting with food and drinks available.

The festival is scheduled for November 1, 2026, starting at 16:00. A suggested donation of 8€ is requested, with a reduced price of 4€ for associates.

O evento inclui performances, workshops e apresentações ou conversas conduzidas por convidados notáveis. Pretende incentivar a reflexão, o debate e a inspiração mútua, conectando participantes e público num ambiente informal com comida e bebidas disponíveis.

O festival está agendado para 1 de novembro de 2026, com início às 16:00. É sugerida uma doação de 8€, com um preço reduzido de 4€ para associados.
